Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come. Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us! *Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in* [*digital-first*](https://blog.junipersquare.com/juniper-square-ponders-future-of-office-with-digital-first-hybrid-workplace-strategy/) *operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.* ## **About the role** We are seeking a highly skilled **Full Stack Principal Engineer** to architect, design, and oversee the development of scalable web applications and distributed systems. The ideal candidate brings strong backend expertise in **Python (FastAPI preferred) or Java**, combined with solid frontend development experience using **ReactJS and TypeScript**. This role will lead the design and delivery of **end-to-end systems—from user-facing applications to backend services and cloud infrastructure**. You will guide engineering teams, drive architectural decisions, and ensure best practices across the full software development lifecycle. **Experience leveraging AI tools and building AI-driven solutions will be a significant advantage**, especially for developing intelligent features, automation, and data-driven capabilities within products. ## **What you’ll do** **Technical Leadership** - Lead the architecture and design of **full-stack applications**, including frontend interfaces, backend services, and cloud infrastructure. - Provide **hands-on technical guidance** to engineering teams and mentor developers across frontend and backend domains. - Define coding standards, enforce code quality, and conduct thorough code reviews. - Drive **end-to-end delivery**, from architecture and development to deployment and maintenance. **Backend Engineering & API Development** - Architect and build backend services using **Python/FastAPI (preferred) or Java (Spring Boot/Quarkus)**. - Design and implement **scalable RESTful and GraphQL APIs** with a strong focus on performance, security, and maintainability. - Build **asynchronous processing pipelines** and microservices using tools like **Celery, RabbitMQ, Redis**, or similar message brokers. - Design efficient **database schemas and queries** using **PostgreSQL, MySQL, or NoSQL databases**. - Implement caching strategies and optimise backend services for high throughput and reliability. **Frontend Development** - Develop modern web applications using **ReactJS and TypeScript**. - Design reusable UI components and scalable frontend architecture. - Implement **state management, API integrations, and responsive user interfaces**. - Collaborate closely with design and product teams to deliver intuitive user experiences. - Ensure frontend applications maintain high standards of **performance, accessibility, and maintainability**. **Cloud & DevOps** - Deploy, manage, and optimise applications on **AWS (EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, IAM, etc.)**. - Implement **CI/CD pipelines**, automated testing, and environment provisioning. - Use **Docker and Kubernetes** for containerization and microservice orchestration. - Ensure system observability through **logging, monitoring, and distributed tracing**. **Architecture & System Design** - Lead discussions on **scalability, distributed architecture, caching strategies, and event-driven patterns**. - Design full-stack solutions that balance **performance, reliability, and user experience**. - Drive adoption of **cloud-native architectures and modern engineering practices**. - Ensure adherence to **security best practices and compliance standards**. **AI & Intelligent Systems (Advantage)** - Leverage modern **AI tools and frameworks** to enhance developer productivity and product capabilities. - Contribute to or lead the development of **AI-powered features**, such as intelligent search, conversational interfaces, recommendation systems, or automation tools. - Work with technologies such as **LLMs, embeddings, semantic search, and RAG pipelines** where relevant. - Evaluate opportunities to integrate **AI-driven capabilities into existing products and workflows**. ## **Qualifications** - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in **Computer Science, Engineering, or related field**. - **12+ years of software engineering experience**, with at least **3+ years in a technical leadership role**. - Strong expertise in: - **Python (FastAPI preferred) OR Java** - **ReactJS and TypeScript** - **REST and GraphQL API development** - **Asynchronous processing (Celery or similar)** - **AWS cloud services** - **Docker, Kubernetes, and containerization** - Solid understanding of: - **Microservices architectures** - **Distributed systems design** - **SQL and NoSQL databases** - **CI/CD pipelines** - **Monitoring and observability frameworks** **Nice to Have** - Experience building **AI-driven applications or integrating AI capabilities into products**. - Experience with **event-driven systems** such as **Kafka, SNS/SQS**. - Exposure to **Domain-Driven Design (DDD)** and **clean architecture principles**. - Knowledge of **Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation)**. - Experience with **performance tuning, load testing, and AWS cost optimization**. **Soft Skills** - Strong leadership, mentoring, and stakeholder management abilities. - Excellent communication and documentation skills. - Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities. - Ability to operate effectively in a **fast-paced, agile environment**.

Headquarters: Americas Remote

About Customer.io

Over 8,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, I’m TJ Jackson, Manager of Account Management at Customer.io, and I’m hiring a Sr. Account Manager to join our North America's team. This is a sales role. You’ll own a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise customers and be accountable for generating expansion pipeline, closing new revenue, and securing renewals.

You’ll build on existing customer relationships and prospect beyond them. That means cold calling people who haven’t worked with us, identifying new buying teams, and winning business with additional brands within the same parent company. You’ll lead discovery, build relationships with multiple stakeholders, and own each deal from the first conversation through negotiation and close.

We’re looking for someone with a track record in B2B sales who can walk us through an expansion deal they sourced and closed. You should be comfortable generating your own pipeline, multi-threading across complex accounts, and using a sales methodology such as MEDDICC to qualify opportunities and move deals forward.

This role is open to candidates based in US and Canada only.

What we value

• Commercial ownership — you treat your book of business like it's yours, because it is

• Forecasting discipline and data-driven decision-making, not gut feel

• Multi-threaded relationships — you build trust across the org, not just with one champion

• Expansion through value, not feature gates or mechanical levers

• Close partnership with Customer Success — you see CS as a collaborator, not a handoff

What you'll do

• Own the full commercial strategy for a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise accounts — renewals, expansion, and churn mitigation

• Drive growth by helping customers adopt Customer.io more strategically, identifying new use cases and articulating ROI clearly

• Forecast renewal and expansion pipeline accurately with a clear, repeatable methodology

• Build multi-threaded relationships from day-to-day operators to Directors and VPs, becoming a trusted commercial advisor

• Partner closely with Customer Success on account health and with Sales on expansion deals

• Engage Legal and Finance on complex renewals and collaborate cross-functionally to move deals forward

What we're looking for

• 3+ years in Sr. Account Management, Sales, or a related SaaS commercial role with direct ownership of a revenue number (5+ years preferred)

• Experience managing $5m ARR, predominantly in the MM space

• Proven ability to grow customer spend outside of overages or true-ups — genuine expansion through adoption and value articulation

• A forecasting methodology you can walk through clearly — it doesn't need to be a named framework, just logic you own

• Comfortable pulling usage data, tracking health scores, and building your own dashboards

• Strong communicator — clear and persuasive with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Based in the UK or Ireland

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $142,900 - $171,000 OTE USD (or equivalent in your local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. This role is a 70/30 OTE split. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

• 30-minute video call with a Recruiter

• 45-minute video call with the Hiring Manager

• Take-Home Assignment

• 1-hour Assignment Review Call with the team

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you're excited by what you read — apply now.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/customer-io-sr-account-manager-amer-remote

Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

• 
Experience working in Data Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, Data Analytics, or Cloud technology projects.

• 
Familiarity with technologies and platforms such as Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, and modern data platforms.

• 
Experience working in IT consulting, professional services, or global technology delivery organizations.

•

Servant Leadership

Agile Mindset and Continuous Improvement

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
​
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

We're hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the Semantic Layer team in Bengaluru. You'll own the health, delivery, and growth of the team behind MetricFlow — building and coaching a group of engineers, setting technical direction in partnership with your leads, and ensuring one of the most important projects in the modern data stack keeps shipping with quality and momentum.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll spend most of your time growing people, running a healthy delivery process, and shaping strategy — but you'll stay close enough to the code and the architecture to make sound technical calls and earn the trust of a senior engineering team. You'll also be the steward of a public, community-facing open-source project, balancing the needs of internal roadmap and external contributors.

About the team

The Semantic Layer team owns the systems that turn dbt models into trusted, reusable business metrics. At the heart of this is MetricFlow — the open-source semantic engine that powers the dbt Semantic Layer. MetricFlow lets data teams define metrics once in code and consume them consistently across BI tools, notebooks, AI agents, and downstream applications.

This team is the steward of MetricFlow as an open-source project: shipping releases, reviewing community contributions, evolving the query compiler, and ensuring it integrates cleanly with the broader dbt ecosystem. The team works at the intersection of language design, query compilation, and distributed data execution — solving problems that directly shape how thousands of organizations measure their business.

What you'll do

• 

Lead, coach, and grow a team of software engineers building MetricFlow — hiring, onboarding, career development, performance management, and day-to-day support.

• 

Own delivery for the Semantic Layer team: planning, prioritization, execution, and predictable shipping of high-quality software.

• 

Partner with your senior and staff engineers to set technical direction across metric definitions, query compilation, dimensional modeling, and SQL generation for multiple data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, and others).

• 

Steward MetricFlow as an open-source project — set the bar for how the team triages issues, reviews external pull requests, manages releases, and engages the community on GitHub and in Slack.

• 

Collaborate with engineering leaders across the dbt platform, dbt Core, and the Semantic Layer service to ensure MetricFlow integrates seamlessly with the rest of the dbt ecosystem.

• 

Partner with product, design, and developer-relations counterparts to translate customer and community feedback into a clear, well-sequenced roadmap.

• 

Drive engineering excellence in performance, reliability, and observability of metric query execution at scale.

• 

Foster a culture of design docs, thoughtful code review, and durable engineering — shipping fast without shipping sloppy.

Skills we're looking for

• 

Experience managing software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, and performance management, with a track record of shipping production systems.

• 

A strong engineering foundation — you've built and shipped production software yourself and can engage credibly on architecture and technical tradeoffs with a senior team.

• 

Familiarity with the technical domain: SQL fundamentals, how analytical query engines and data warehouses execute queries, and systems that involve parsing, compilation, or transformation (query planners, DSL compilers, type systems, or rule-based engines).

• 

Solid grasp of software design principles: clean APIs, modularity, testability, and backwards compatibility — and the judgment to hold a team to them.

• 

Excellent written and verbal communication — you can explain complex tradeoffs clearly to engineers, product managers, and external community members.

• 

Experience leading in a distributed, asynchronous team environment.

Nice to have

• 

Experience leading or contributing to a popular open-source project, including managing a community of external contributors.

• 

Familiarity with dbt, MetricFlow, LookML, Cube, or other semantic-layer technologies.

• 

Background in data warehousing internals, query optimization, or analytical SQL dialects.

• 

Experience with CI/CD, GitHub Actions, and release engineering for Python libraries.

• 

Exposure to building developer-facing APIs, SDKs, or CLIs.

Why join us

• 

Impact at scale: Your team's code will run inside the data platforms of tens of thousands of companies, including some of the world's largest enterprises.

• 

Open-source ownership: You'll lead the team behind a foundational open-source project — visible, reviewed, and used by the global data community.

A team that values craft: We invest in design docs, code review, and durable engineering. We ship fast, but we don't ship sloppy.

About the Role:
Hi there! We're hiring an Information Security Engineer with a focus on Application Security to join our Information Security team at Camunda.

We are a team that takes security seriously without making it feel like a locked door. We work in a transparent, straightforward way, and we care about doing the work right rather than just checking a compliance box.

You will work side by side with our R&D engineers: reviewing designs, threat modeling new features, digging into code and helping teams make good, risk-based decisions about the vulnerabilities that come in. You'll also help build the internal tools that make this work scale, including our CVE registry and the LLM-assisted workflows we use to analyse code and triage findings.
Camunda is an AI-first company, and InfoSec is no exception: AI agents are part of how we review code, assess vulnerabilities, and build our tools. You will help shape how that works.

This is a hands-on role for someone who already has solid AppSec foundations and wants to grow. We are a generalist team, so you will also take part in our on-call rotation and incident response, and get exposure to other areas of security. But most of your time will be spent with engineers and building and maintaining internal tools and processes.

What You Will Do
• 
Vulnerability management: triage findings from SCA, container and code scanning, external reports and internal security testing; assess whether Camunda is actually affected; agree fix / mitigate / accept with engineering and follow through to release.
• 
Threat modeling and security reviews: run threat modeling sessions and design reviews with R&D teams for new features and architecture changes, and turn the results into concrete, prioritised actions.
• 
Code analysis with LLMs: use and improve LLM-assisted tooling (agents, prompts, reusable skills) to review code, validate findings and reproduce issues, while applying your own judgement to know when the model is wrong.
• 
Build internal security tooling: contribute to the CVE registry and related automation that connects scanners, engineering teams, and customer communication. Much of it is built on Camunda itself.
• 
Help engineers do the secure thing by default: answer questions, review pull requests, improve guidelines and occasionally run a session or workshop.
• 
On-call and incident response: share the InfoSec on-call rotation with the other engineers and help investigate and resolve security incidents.
• 
Support the wider team: help write security advisories for our customers, answer customer security questions and support audits.
What You Will Bring to the Role
• 
Around 3+ years in security or software engineering, with at least 2 of them working on application or product security (AppSec, product security, pentesting, or a security-focused developer role all count).
• 
Experience at a SaaS or software product company, working closely with engineering teams that ship often through modern CI/CD and cloud environments.
• 
Hands-on vulnerability triage: you've worked with tools like Snyk, Trivy, Semgrep, CodeQL or similar, can tell a real issue from a false positive, and can explain how exploitable something actually is in context (CVSS, exploitability, configuration).
• 
Threat modeling and design review experience (e.g. STRIDE) on real systems, ideally web apps, APIs, or distributed services.
• 
You read and write code. You're comfortable reading Java (Camunda is built on it) well enough to follow a data flow and spot a security bug. You can write scripts and small tools and contribute to an existing codebase with review.
• 
You build with AI, not just chat with it. You use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar) in your daily work to write tools, analyse code or automate tasks. And you know their output still needs a second look, especially when it comes to security.
• 
Clear, friendly communication with engineers. You see yourself as an enabler, not a gatekeeper, and you can explain risk to people who aren't security specialists.

Nice to haves
• 
Some Python and/or JavaScript experience, or experience building internal tools.
• 
Willingness to learn and use Camunda, since we build a lot of our own security automation on it. Prior BPMN / workflow experience is a plus.
• 
Experience responding to security incidents or being part of an on-call rotation.
• 
Exposure to security advisories, CVE disclosure or bug bounty programmes.
• 
Knowledge of AI/LLM security risks (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs / agentic apps, prompt injection, tool abuse).
• 
Experience securing Kubernetes or container-based workloads, or open-source / B2B software.

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.
The Opportunity 

Carrot is expanding its telemedicine clinic with a network of part-time to full-time, fully remote Registered Nurses who deliver evidence-based virtual care to members across all U.S. states. As an RN in this network, you are often the first clinical touchpoint for members navigating fertility, menopause, hormonal, and metabolic health journeys, providing triage, education, care coordination, and documentation that shape the entire care experience.

All work in this role is performed within RN scope of practice. RNs provide triage, education, care coordination, and documentation; they do not diagnose, do not prescribe, and do not independently modify a treatment plan. Anything requiring clinical judgment beyond RN scope is routed to a physician, so sound escalation judgment is central to the role.

This is a contractor engagement of approximately 20-40 hours per week, with scheduled shifts within the Monday-Friday, 8:00a-6:00p CST coverage window. 

What You’ll Own 

In this role, you will:

• Serve as the first clinical reviewer of inbound member messages, triaging for urgency, escalating to a physician when needed, and routing non-clinical threads to the appropriate support team.

• Deliver member education on menopause staging, hormone therapy, preconception health, metabolic health, and medication administration.

• Review and triage incoming lab results, escalate critical findings per protocol, retrieve outside records, and coordinate specialist referrals.

• Manage pharmacy callbacks and prior authorizations in coordination with the care team.

• Document all clinically relevant interactions same-day, create tracked internal tasks with named owners, and follow established escalation pathways.

• Maintain active NLC multi-state licensure, complete required credentialing and onboarding, and adhere to HIPAA, continuing education, and liability coverage requirements.

• Contribute to chart audits and clinical protocol feedback as the telemedicine program scales.

What Success Looks Like  

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

• Established a consistent record of accurate, protocol-aligned triage with appropriate physician escalation and no missed critical lab values.

• Maintained same-day documentation and timely lab follow-up, with no outstanding credentialing or compliance gaps.

• Delivered high-quality member education across menopause, preconception, hormone therapy, and metabolic health topics, reflected in strong member experience results.

• Managed care coordination workflows reliably within your coverage window, including referrals, records retrieval, prior authorizations, and pharmacy callbacks.

• Contributed to chart audits, protocol feedback, and quality improvement as the telemedicine program scales.

About You 

You likely have:

• An active, unrestricted RN license with NLC (Nurse Licensure Compact) multi-state privileges, in good standing, plus an ADN or BSN from an accredited program (BSN preferred).

• A minimum of 3 years of active RN clinical experience, with meaningful experience in women's health, reproductive health, OB/GYN, fertility, endocrinology, Urology, Mens Health, or menopause care.

• Demonstrated nurse triage experience, including assessing urgency, applying protocol, escalating appropriately, and recognizing critical lab values.

• A clear understanding of RN scope of practice and sound judgment about when to escalate.

• Strong written communication for asynchronous messaging and a strong phone presence for symptom assessment and instruction.

• Proficiency with EHR and telehealth systems, secure messaging, and e-fax workflows.

• Familiarity with HIPAA and applicable telemedicine privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.

• The ability to commit to scheduled shifts within the Monday-Friday, 8:00a-6:00p CST coverage window, with a HIPAA-compliant, private home workspace and reliable internet.

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

• Experience in a dedicated menopause clinic, fertility center, REI practice, or comparable specialty program.

• Familiarity with preconception and fertility workup, including AMH and hormone panels, ovulation tracking, and cycle-monitoring labs.

• Hormone therapy education experience, including prior authorization workflows.

• Experience supporting members on anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists.

• Prior experience in digital health, health benefits, or multi-state telemedicine environments.

• Experience contributing to clinical protocol development, quality improvement, or member-facing clinical content.

• Experience supporting diverse and historically underserved populations, including LGBTQ+ and gender-diverse individuals.

• Relevant certification (e.g., MSCP through The Menopause Society, RNC-OB) and/or fluency in an additional language.

Why This Role Matters 

Carrot's RN network is the front line of the telemedicine clinic. RNs are typically the first clinician a member reaches, and the quality of their triage judgment, education, and follow-through directly determines member safety, trust, and the experience of care during some of the most personal moments of members' lives.

This role also keeps the clinical program running well as it scales. Reliable triage, same-day documentation, and disciplined escalation protect physician capacity for the decisions that require it, while expanding access to guideline-aligned fertility, menopause, and metabolic health support for members who often cannot find it locally.

Why Candidates Join Carrot 

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

• A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.

• A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.

• Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

• Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.

• Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.

• A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.

• The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation: 

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $40-$50/ hr. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join Rubrik's Applied AI Apps org, building production-grade, full-stack applications and APIs for our internal Business teams while embedding AI-agentified capabilities into these internal platforms. This is a hands-on build role: you will own features end to end from database schema through backend services and distributed systems to the user interface and bring practical, hands-on experience building or integrating AI agents, tool-calling workflows along with the right AI evals or LLM-powered features into production systems that our business stakeholders rely on.

The ideal candidate combines strong full-stack engineering fundamentals with a systems mindset for reliability and scale, and has spent meaningful hands-on time (1–2 years) building AI-agentified applications not just experimenting with AI tools, but shipping agentic features in production. We are targeting 8+ years of overall software engineering experience; this is flexible for candidates who demonstrate strong depth across full-stack, distributed systems, and applied AI engineering skills during technical evaluation.

What you'll do

Key Responsibilities:

 

  • Build and productionize agentic workflows, LLM-powered automation, and AI-assisted tooling having hands-on experience with these systems.
  • Design and build end-to-end agent evaluation frameworks that measure correctness, latency, cost, safety, and task completion rate, including synthetic test environments that stress-test agents built on Google ADK and Google AI/ML services (Vertex AI, Gemini) under diverse real-world conditions.
  • Curate golden datasets and test harnesses for our Rubrik enterprise use cases and contribute to an eval-as-a-service platform that IT teams can self-serve against standard and custom benchmarks.
  • Automate regression and drift detection with CI/CD-integrated eval pipelines that catch regressions on every model or prompt change before production deployments
  • Architect for distributed systems concerns: scalability, fault tolerance, data consistency, and service boundaries across backend and data layers.
  • Build full-stack web applications and own features end to end be it database schema, backend services, APIs (REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and webhooks), and frontend (React/Next.js) user interface
  • Design and build APIs and services that are consumed by applications, internal tools, and AI agents/LLMs, including tool-calling interfaces
  • Apply reliability engineering practices — observability (logging, metrics, tracing), SLAs/SLOs, incident response, and post-incident reviews — to keep production systems healthy.
  • Clarify requirements upfront, surface blockers early, and communicate progress proactively without being asked.
  • Collaborate openly with internal Business stakeholders, Product, QA, DevOps, and UX or designer teams; avoid working in silos.

 

Experience you'll need

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 5-7 years of Salesforce experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud (or Pardot), Channel/Partner Portals, and Salesforce Admin functionalities. 
  • Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud and Case Management is a plus.
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting complex issues involving Apex, Flows, Workflows, Process Builder, Validation Rules, Reports & Dashboards.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce integration tools (e.g., MuleSoft, Zapier, Marketing Automation Platforms).
  • Salesforce Administrator certification is required; additional certifications (e.g., Platform App Builder, Marketing Cloud Administrator, Marketing Cloud Email Specialist) are a plus.

Required Qualification

 

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience across full-stack engineering (flexible based on demonstrated strength in technical evaluation).
  • 1–2 years of hands-on experience building, integrating and operating AI Agent powered applications (agentic workflows, tool-calling, RAG, LLM-powered features) in production..
  • Demonstrated experience owning systems designed for scale and reliability, not just feature delivery.

Technical Skills — Applied AI Engineering

  • 1–2 years of hands-on experience building AI applications, using agent frameworks (e.g., Claude Agent SDK, Google ADK, LangGraph, or equivalent).
  • Practical understanding of latency, cost, rate limiting, and safety/guardrails when exposing systems for AI consumption.
  • Experience with coding agents, Spec Driven and Eval Driven Development
  • Deep hands-on experience with LLM evaluation — familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as LangSmith, DeepEval, LLM as a Judge, Promptfoo, RAGAS, Hugging Face evaluation tooling, custom eval harnesses
  • Strong understanding of agentic AI patterns — Supervisor Multi-Agent, ReAct/Plan-Execute reasoning chains, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)

Technical Skills — Full Stack Software Engineering

  • Frontend: Strong JavaScript fundamentals; hands-on experience with React and Next.js for building modern, production-grade web applications (hooks, state management, component architecture, routing, server-side rendering).
  • Backend: Proficient in Python, writing production-grade code; hands-on experience with FastAPI or Flask (or equivalent frameworks) for building REST APIs.
  • Database: Experience with relational and non-relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, or equivalent); solid understanding of schema design, joins, indexing, and query optimization.
  • APIs: Secure API design, API Gateway expertise with platforms such as Kong / Apigee / AWS API Gateway / Azure APIM / MuleSoft API Gateway for routing, rate limiting, and policy enforcement.

Technical Skills — Distributed Systems & Reliability Engineering

  • Working knowledge of distributed systems concepts: service decomposition, consistency models, caching, queuing/messaging, and failure handling.

ccba1c2311108177.description: You will own AI-native product surfaces end to end - from problem framing through model behaviour, evals, UX, working code and adoption on the hotel floor. This is not a roadmap-admin role. You will scope the feature, write the PRD, tune the prompt, then build it yourself in Claude Code, Cursor or Antigravity and ship the PR to engineering for review. **What you'll do** * Own AI product behaviour * Define how our agents should behave - intent capture, tool use, handoffs, confirmations, refusals, escalation to humans. * Write and iterate system prompts, knowledge structures and conversation flows with engineering, not just requirements for them. * Decide when a problem needs an LLM, a rule, a form or a button - and push back when AI is the wrong answer. * Scope it, build it, ship the PR * After scoping, build the feature yourself with Claude Code, Cursor or Antigravity - working code in our repo, not a mock. * Open PRs with tests and a clear description; engineering reviews, hardens and merges. * Own the scope-to-PR loop for small and mid-size features; hand off to engineering where architecture, scale or security calls for it. * Prototype prompt, flow and UI changes against the real stack to validate before they take roadmap time. * Follow codebase conventions, CI checks and review feedback - PRs that land, not PRs that get rewritten. * Build and run evals * Set up eval sets, rubrics and golden conversations for chat and voice agents. * Catch score inflation and false confidence - make sure the numbers reflect what guests and staff actually experience. * Turn transcript reviews and failure analysis into prioritised fixes and roadmap items. * Ship across guest and staff surfaces * Write clear, PM-level PRDs and TRD reviews for features across products. * Own problems end to end, from concept to delivery & monitoring. **What you bring** * 4+ years of product management in B2B SaaS, enterprise software or platform products. * Hands-on experience shipping at least one LLM-powered product or feature to real users - chat, agents, voice, search or copilots. * Daily user of AI coding tools - Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity or similar - with code you wrote merged into a production codebase. * Working fluency with how LLMs behave: prompting, RAG, tool/function calling, structured outputs, hallucination modes, context limits. * Writes sharp documents. PRDs that engineers can build from and leadership can decide from. * Strong product taste for interaction cost - you notice an extra tap, an extra turn, an extra confirmation. * Owns outcomes in an early-stage, high-ambiguity environment without needing a fully formed process. **Nice to have** * Hospitality, travel or luxury retail experience - hotel ops, PMS, guest experience or booking. * Design sensibility - comfortable in Figma, prototyping flows yourself.

Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next HR Partner. 

About the job

This position is needed to support delivery of People priorities. This role supports a number of business functions and HRBPs located in the APJ region. You will be an integral part of the HR Partners' team, reporting to the Senior Director of Global HR Partners, and partnering closely with and supporting the work of international and functional HRBPs and COEs across the People team. 

We are looking for someone who lives the Twilio Magic and has a demonstrated track record of providing advice and assistance with HR queries in a wide variety of areas including benefits & compensation, offboarding, global mobility and employee relations.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Partner with the HRBP team supporting our APJ region functions to support program roll-outs and on-going process execution
  • Analyse HR data and trends across the organisation they support (e.g. headcount, attrition, performance) to generate insights, trends and prepare clear and customised reports, metrics and presentation materials for HRBPs and senior leadership to support decision-making
  • Own and manage performance management cases end-to-end, partnering with managers to ensure fair, consistent, and timely outcomes in line with company policy
  • Coach and guide managers through the performance management process, providing advice, documentation support, and best practice to build manager capability and ensure a positive employee experience
  • Support HR Leaders on ad hoc projects
  • Help to execute and where required lead business led initiatives (re-orgs, job role and level assessments, etc)
  • Partner cross functionally with key stakeholders: Talent Management,  IT, ER, HR operations, Compliance, Recruiting, Compensation, etc. to ensure communications, program, and process alignment
  • Program Management- annual cyclical events such as calibration, pulse surveys etc
  • Maintain confidentiality of core HR data and projects

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • 3+ years experience in an HR role in a matrixed organisation
  • Ability to take initiative and be a self-starter
  • You are a decisive problem solver with a "get it done" attitude who will thrive in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment
  • Strong ability to make administrative and procedural decisions and exercise judgment with sensitive and confidential issues
  • Strong data analysis skills and ability to share recommendations with stakeholders
  • Data Storytelling: Connects internal data with external benchmarks to provide actionable executive insights
  • AI-Enabled Efficiency: Enhances productivity through the sensible and strategic usage of AI tools.
  • Demonstrates employee focus and managing proactive communication to ensure optimum HR support
  • Leads the alignment between GTM and marketing HRBPs and COEs to ensure programs are scalable and reflect unique functional needs.
  • Keen to continue learning and developing their skill set, having a growth mindset
  • Strong ability to identify process gaps and improvement opportunities 

Desired:

  • Proficiency with HR systems, such as Workday and ServiceNow 

Location

 This role will be remote, and based in India (only in Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Maharashtra, Delhi).

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
